notices.title: Not connected
notices.reason: The DSPi is not connected, or it went away.
notices.action: Connect the DSPi and try again.

notices.title: Transfer failed
notices.reason: The DSPi did not answer as expected.
notices.action: Try again. If it keeps failing, reconnect the DSPi.

notices.title: Change refused
notices.reason: The DSPi refused the request.
notices.action: Check the value and try again.

notices.title: Not a valid value
notices.reason: A value was out of range or not understood.
notices.action: Check the value and try again.

notices.title: Not available
notices.reason: The connected firmware does not have this feature.
notices.action: Update the DSPi's firmware to use it.

notices.title: Read-only
notices.reason: This firmware's settings can be shown but not changed in this version.
notices.action: Update the app or the DSPi's firmware to make changes.

notices.title: Read-only mode
notices.reason: This console is in read-only mode: the DSPi's settings are shown but nothing is sent to it.
notices.action: Turn read-only mode off to make changes.

notices.title: A safe apply is waiting
notices.reason: Read-only mode cannot start while a safe apply waits for Keep or Revert: its way back would be refused.
notices.action: Keep or revert the change, then turn read-only mode on.

notices.title: Another console is applying changes
notices.reason: The hub lets one console change the DSPi at a time.
notices.action: Wait a moment and try again.

notices.title: Not allowed
notices.reason: This console's role on the hub does not allow that change.
notices.action: Ask an Admin of the hub for the Control role.

notices.title: DSPi Link failed
notices.reason: The connection to the hub failed.
notices.action: Check the hub and the network, then connect again.

notices.title: Wrong PIN
notices.reason: The hub did not accept the PIN.
notices.action: Check the PIN the hub shows and enter it again.

notices.title: Too many attempts
notices.reason: The hub refuses new attempts for a while.
notices.action: Wait a minute, then try again.

notices.title: Hub busy
notices.reason: The hub has no free session.
notices.action: Close another console's connection, or try again later.

notices.title: A different hub
notices.reason: The hub at this address is not the one paired before.
notices.action: Pair with this hub again if it replaced the old one.

notices.title: The hub refused the connection
notices.reason: The hub did not let this console in.
notices.action: Check the hub's settings, then connect again.

notices.title: The hub did not answer
notices.reason: No answer came from the hub in time.
notices.action: Check the network, then connect again.

notices.title: Connection closed
notices.reason: The hub closed the connection.
notices.action: Connect again to continue.

notices.title: Still reading the DSPi
notices.reason: The DSPi's settings are still being read.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: unsecured
notices.reason: The connection to this hub is not encrypted.
notices.action: Fine on a trusted local network or over a VPN; see the details for more.

notices.title: Unencrypted connection
notices.reason: The connection to this hub is not encrypted. That is fine on a trusted local network or over a VPN, but on any other network someone could read or change what is sent, including the pairing PIN and settings.
notices.action: If the hub supports encryption, turn TLS on in its settings, or turn its upstream compatibility mode off; this console then connects encrypted by itself.

notices.title: File not read or written
notices.reason: A file could not be read or written.
notices.action: Check the file and its folder, then try again.

notices.title: AutoEQ update failed
notices.reason: The headphone database could not be updated.
notices.action: Try again later.

notices.title: AutoEQ update paused
notices.reason: The server asked to wait before the next update.
notices.action: Try again later.

notices.title: AutoEQ update failed
notices.reason: The server could not be reached.
notices.action: Check the network connection, then try again.

notices.title: Firmware not installed
notices.reason: This firmware image can leave the DSPi's core voltage too low. Nothing was written.
notices.action: Choose a different firmware image.

notices.title: Not a verified DSPi Console image
notices.reason: This file is not one of the firmware images that come with DSPi Console, so it could not be checked against them.
notices.action: Flash it only if you know where it came from, such as your own build. The usual checks still apply.

notices.title: Confirmation needed
notices.reason: This raises the core voltage above 1.20 V. Nothing was written.
notices.action: Type OVERVOLT to confirm, or keep the current voltage.

notices.title: Not confirmed
notices.reason: This change needs a confirmation, and it was missing, was for another change, or had run out. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Confirm the change again.

notices.title: Outside the limits
notices.reason: The installer's limits profile for this DSPi does not allow that value. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose a value within the limits, or ask the installer to change them.

notices.title: Limits profile unreadable
notices.reason: The limits profile for this DSPi could not be read, so the last good copy of it is in force.
notices.action: Ask the installer to check the limits profile and save it again.

notices.title: Limits profile unreadable
notices.reason: The limits profile for this DSPi could not be read and there is no good copy of it, so no limits are in force.
notices.action: Ask the installer to set the limits profile again.

notices.title: Limits apply here only
notices.reason: The DSPi itself does not know these limits: a control surface, the UART or a console without this profile can still go past them.
notices.action: Set the same profile on every console that controls this DSPi.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: The installer has locked this DSPi on this console: only volume, mute and presets can be changed. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Ask the installer, or unlock with the installer's PIN.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: The installer has locked this DSPi on this console: only volume, mute and presets can be changed. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Ask the installer, or unlock with the installer's PIN.

notices.title: Installer PIN needed
notices.reason: An installer PIN is set for this DSPi on this console, so this needs the Installer unlock. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Unlock with the installer's PIN, then try again.

notices.title: Wrong PIN
notices.reason: That is not the installer's PIN or recovery code for this DSPi.
notices.action: Check the PIN and enter it again.

notices.title: Too many wrong PINs
notices.reason: After several wrong PINs, new attempts are refused for a while.
notices.action: Wait until the time shown, then try again.

notices.title: No installer PIN set
notices.reason: No installer PIN is set for this DSPi on this console, so there is nothing to lock.
notices.action: Set an installer PIN in the Installer mode first.

notices.title: This lock is on this console
notices.reason: This lock is on this console; the DSPi itself is open. It is a lock for everyday use, not a security boundary: another console or tool can still change the DSPi.
notices.action: For real access control, connect the DSPi through a hub and use its roles.

notices.title: Keep the recovery code
notices.reason: The recovery code unlocks this DSPi on this console if the PIN is forgotten. It is shown only now.
notices.action: Write it in the hand-over note and keep it away from the system's users.

notices.title: Only an Admin may write this
notices.reason: This DSPi has a limits profile or an installer lock on its hub, so the hub lets only an Admin write its whole state at once. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Change single settings instead, or connect to the hub as an Admin.

notices.title: Limits could not be checked
notices.reason: The hub could not read this DSPi's state to check the change against its limits profile. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: Locked on the hub
notices.reason: The hub this DSPi is connected through holds its installer lock, so the hub's PIN unlocks it for this console.
notices.action: Enter the installer's PIN for this DSPi on the hub.

notices.title: Locked by the installer
notices.reason: Locked by the installer: only volume, mute and presets can be changed.
notices.action: Unlock with the installer's PIN to change more.

notices.title: Editing the hub's copy
notices.reason: This DSPi is reached through a hub, so these limits, the installer PIN and the pinned modes are the hub's: they hold for every console on the hub.
notices.action: Changes apply on the hub at once. Connect the DSPi directly to edit this console's own copy.

notices.title: Editing this console's copy
notices.reason: This DSPi is connected directly, so these limits and the installer PIN are this console's own copy.
notices.action: When the DSPi is reached through a hub, the hub's copy is the one in force and edited.

notices.title: Read-only: Admin needed
notices.reason: Only an Admin of the hub may change its limits, installer PIN and pinned modes. A console paired with the hub's PIN is a Control client.
notices.action: On the hub's machine, find this console with uconsole hub clients and run uconsole hub role <cid> admin (hub stopped), or type role <cid> admin at the running hub's prompt, where it applies at once.

notices.title: Read-only: Admin needed
notices.reason: Only an Admin of the hub may change its alarm rules, schedules, notifications, MQTT settings and API keys. A console paired with the hub's PIN is a Control client.
notices.action: On the hub's machine, find this console with uconsole hub clients and run uconsole hub role <cid> admin (hub stopped), or type role <cid> admin at the running hub's prompt, where it applies at once.

notices.title: Not on the hub
notices.reason: The hub does not know this DSPi, snapshot or record (it may have been forgotten or deleted).
notices.action: Refresh the list and choose again.

notices.title: The DSPi is not attached
notices.reason: The hub knows this DSPi, but it is not attached now. Nothing was sent, and nothing is kept for later.
notices.action: Attach the DSPi to the hub and try again.

notices.title: The hub's copy differs
notices.reason: The hub refused this because its own state disagrees: it holds a different copy, a store is full, a document is too large, or another change is waiting.
notices.action: Refresh, then keep the hub's copy or save this one under a new name.

notices.title: Hub busy
notices.reason: The hub is handling as many requests as it takes at once.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: The DSPi refused
notices.reason: The hub sent the command, and the DSPi refused it.
notices.action: Check the value and the DSPi's state, then try again.

notices.title: This hub keeps no limits
notices.reason: The hub this DSPi is reached through does not keep limits profiles or installer PINs, so there is nothing to edit here.
notices.action: Update the hub, or connect the DSPi directly to edit this console's copy.

notices.title: Compatibility mode is on
notices.reason: This hub runs in upstream compatibility mode, so it also takes unencrypted connections, for DSPi Link clients that cannot encrypt.
notices.action: When no such client needs it any more, start the hub without --upstream-compat, and connect again.

notices.title: Security downgraded: upstream compatibility mode is on
notices.reason: This hub also takes unencrypted DSPi Link connections, so upstream clients can connect. On those connections nothing is encrypted: anyone on this network can read the traffic, including PINs, tokens and API keys, and change it in transit. The hub's key is not pinned on them, so a client cannot tell this hub from another machine posing as it. Pairing with a PIN is allowed without encryption, so a listener can take the token a new client is given. Every REST API key works without encryption, not only keys minted for it. The hub does not advertise that it requires encryption.
notices.action: Use it only on a network you trust, and only while you need it. To turn it off, start the hub on its machine without --upstream-compat.

notices.title: Keep the recovery code
notices.reason: The recovery code unlocks this DSPi on the hub if the PIN is forgotten; an Admin of the hub can also clear the PIN. It is shown only now.
notices.action: Write it in the hand-over note and keep it away from the system's users.

notices.title: Configuration not read
notices.reason: The file is not a DSPi configuration this version reads. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose another file, or update the app if the file came from a newer version.

notices.title: Nothing selected
notices.reason: No part of the configuration was chosen to apply. Nothing was changed.
notices.action: Choose at least one part to apply.

notices.title: Still reading the DSPi
notices.reason: The DSPi's settings have not been read yet.
notices.action: Try again in a moment.

notices.title: Keep these settings?
notices.reason: They go back in {s} s unless you press Keep.
notices.action: Press Keep to keep them, or Revert to go back now.

notices.title: The hub keeps the way back too
notices.reason: The hub puts them back too if this console goes away.
notices.action: Press Keep or Revert here as usual.

notices.title: DSPi not attached
notices.reason: The hub has not seen this DSPi since {time}.
notices.action: Check its cable and its power.

notices.title: DSPi not answering
notices.reason: The DSPi is attached to the hub but has not answered since {time}.
notices.action: Check its power, or unplug it and plug it in again.

notices.title: Restarted at {time} ({reason})
notices.reason: The DSPi started again by itself.
notices.action: If it happens again, check its power supply and save a diagnostics bundle.

notices.title: Clipping
notices.reason: The signal reached full scale on the DSPi.
notices.action: Lower the input level or the gain.

notices.title: Running hot
notices.reason: The DSPi's temperature reached the alarm's threshold.
notices.action: Give it more air, or lower the load.

notices.title: Processing load high
notices.reason: The DSPi's processing load stayed at or above the alarm's threshold.
notices.action: Use fewer filters or channels.

notices.title: A schedule did not complete
notices.reason: Some actions of a schedule failed at {time}.
notices.action: Look at the schedule's last run to see which, then run it again if needed.

notices.title: The hub's clock is not set
notices.reason: Schedules wait until the hub's clock reads the right time.
notices.action: Set the hub's clock, or let it set itself from the network.

notices.title: Audio link lost
notices.reason: A unit is not locked to the audio link.
notices.action: Check the audio link cable to that unit.

notices.title: Unit not attached
notices.reason: A unit of the audio link system is not attached to the hub.
notices.action: Attach it again, or take it out of the system.

notices.title: Audio link errors
notices.reason: The audio link is receiving damaged frames.
notices.action: Check the audio link cables and connectors.

notices.title: Audio link caught up
notices.reason: A unit's audio had a short silence while the link caught up.
notices.action: Nothing to do unless it happens again.

notices.title: System muted
notices.reason: The audio link system's mute is on.
notices.action: Unmute the system to hear it.

notices.title: Delay too short
notices.reason: A unit's audio link delay is below what it needs to stay in step.
notices.action: Raise the system's delay.

notices.title: USB-direct unit cannot lock
notices.reason: A USB-direct unit cannot stay in step with the audio link.
notices.action: Check its USB connection and the system's delay.

notices.title: Re-align failed
notices.reason: The hub could not write a USB-direct unit's output delays.
notices.action: Check that the unit is attached, then align the system again.

notices.title: Setting put back
notices.reason: The hub put a USB-direct unit's lock-error action back to the system's.
notices.action: Nothing to do.

notices.title: USB-direct units re-aligned
notices.reason: The hub wrote the USB-direct units' output delays again to keep them aligned.
notices.action: Nothing to do.

notices.title: Firmware update failed
notices.reason: The hub could not finish updating this DSPi's firmware.
notices.action: Look at the update's record on the hub to see where it stopped, then start it again if needed.

notices.title: Encrypted connection needed
notices.reason: The hub takes this only over an encrypted connection.
notices.action: Connect to the hub with encryption on, then try again.

notices.title: Checking the DSPi and the image
notices.reason: The hub checks that the DSPi is on its own USB, answering, muted and free, and that the image suits it.
notices.action: If it stops here, do what the hub says: mute the DSPi, wait for its lock, or choose a verified image for its platform.

notices.title: Checking the core voltage
notices.reason: The hub reads the board's core voltage and asks the firmware guard whether the image suits it, with nobody to confirm.
notices.action: If it stops here, the image does not suit this board: choose an image made for its core voltage.

notices.title: Saving the settings
notices.reason: The hub saves the DSPi's settings in its snapshot store before anything changes.
notices.action: If it stops here, make room in the hub's snapshot store and start again.

notices.title: Restarting into the bootloader
notices.reason: The hub sends the DSPi to its bootloader. From here on the update cannot be cancelled.
notices.action: If it stops here, check the DSPi's lock and installer lock, then start again.

notices.title: Finding the board
notices.reason: The hub waits for exactly one board in its bootloader on its own USB.
notices.action: If it stops here, the DSPi may still be in its bootloader: unplug any other board in its bootloader and start again.

notices.title: Writing the firmware
notices.reason: The hub writes the image, reads it back and compares it, then restarts the board.
notices.action: If it stops here, the board may be left in its bootloader: start the update again.

notices.title: Waiting for the DSPi
notices.reason: The hub waits up to 60 s for the DSPi to come back with its new firmware.
notices.action: If it does not come back, check its cable and its power.

notices.title: Checking the new firmware
notices.reason: The hub checks the firmware version, the extensions and the core voltage, and compares the settings with the saved ones.
notices.action: If the settings changed, recall the saved settings from the hub's snapshot store.

notices.title: Firmware update step
notices.reason: The hub reported a step this version does not know.
notices.action: Read the hub's own words, or update the app.

notices.title: Hub alarm
notices.reason: The hub raised an alarm this version does not know.
notices.action: Read the alarm's own words, or update the app.

notices.title: Microphone not available here
notices.reason: Browsers offer the microphone only to a secure page: one served over https or from this machine's own address.
notices.action: Open the console through the hub's https address or the local web console.

notices.title: Microphone not available
notices.reason: This browser cannot capture the microphone the way a measurement needs.
notices.action: Use a current Chromium-based browser or Firefox.

notices.title: Microphone access denied
notices.reason: The browser was not allowed to use the microphone.
notices.action: Allow the microphone for this page in the browser's site settings, then start again.

notices.title: Microphone not found
notices.reason: No microphone was found, or not the one chosen.
notices.action: Connect the measurement microphone, choose it again and start again.

notices.title: Microphone could not be opened
notices.reason: The microphone is in use elsewhere, or it reported an error.
notices.action: Close other programs that use it, or reconnect it, and start again.

notices.title: Microphone lost
notices.reason: The microphone went away while capturing; the capture has stopped.
notices.action: Reconnect the microphone and start again.

notices.title: Microphone capture did not start
notices.reason: The browser opened the microphone but did not start its audio processing: it may have no audio device, or it may block audio for this page.
notices.action: Allow audio for this page in the browser's site settings, check that an audio device is present, and start again.

notices.title: Something went wrong
notices.reason: The request did not complete.
notices.action: Try again.
